q: Ctrl + A selects all the cells in an Excel worksheet.
exp: Ctrl + A shortcut selects all cells in Excel.

q: Which shortcut is used to copy a cell in MS Excel?
exp: Ctrl + C copies a cell in Excel.

q: What is the shortcut to cut a selected text in MS Word?
exp: Ctrl + X cuts a selected text in MS Word.

q: What is the shortcut to paste a copied text in MS Word?
exp: Ctrl + V pastes a copied text in MS Word.

q: Which shortcut is used to undo an action in MS Office software?
exp: Ctrl + Z undoes an action in MS Office.

q: Which of the following is a shortcut to open a new file in MS Word?
exp: Ctrl + N opens a new file in MS Word.

q: How can you delete a selected sentence in MS Word?
exp: Ctrl + Z is not correct, Alt + Backspace deletes a selected sentence in MS Word.

q: What is the shortcut to open a saved file in MS Excel?

q: Which of the following is a shortcut to print a document in MS Word?
exp: Ctrl + P prints a document in MS Word.

q: What is the shortcut to save a file in MS Excel?
exp: Ctrl + S saves a file in MS Excel.

q: How can you undo a deletion in MS Office software?
exp: Ctrl + Z undoes a deletion in MS Office.
